WITH movements AS (SELECT j.id AS journal_id,l.id AS line_id,j.entry_date,j.reference,j.description,
            COALESCE(j.source_book,'Legacy General Journal') AS source_book,
            CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(j.party_snapshot) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(j.party_snapshot,'$.name')) ELSE NULL END AS party_name,
            l.project_code_snapshot,l.project_name_snapshot,l.debit_amount,l.credit_amount,
            SUM(l.debit_amount-l.credit_amount) OVER (ORDER BY j.entry_date,j.id,l.id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS movement_balance
            FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id=l.journal_entry_id
            WHERE l.account_id=? AND j.status='posted' AND j.entry_date>=? AND j.entry_date<?) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (?='' OR LOCATE(?,CONCAT_WS(' ',journal_id,source_book,reference,description,party_name,project_code_snapshot,project_name_snapshot))>0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS matched,
            COALESCE(SUM(debit_amount),0) AS debits,COALESCE(SUM(credit_amount),0) AS credits FROM movements

            FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN journal_entries j ON j.id=l.journal_entry_id
            WHERE l.account_id=? AND j.status='posted' AND j.entry_date>=? AND j.entry_date<?) SELECT * FROM movements WHERE (?='' OR LOCATE(?,CONCAT_WS(' ',journal_id,source_book,reference,description,party_name,project_code_snapshot,project_name_snapshot))>0) ORDER BY entry_date,journal_id,line_id LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()
        AND TABLE_NAME IN ('projects','parties','journal_drafts','draft_evidence_reservations',
        'advance_control_designations','posted_evidence_associations','evidence_allocations','accounting_write_state')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()
        AND TABLE_NAME='journal_entries' AND COLUMN_NAME IN ('source_book','transaction_kind','party_id','party_snapshot')

SELECT CategoryID,Name,Account_Code,Account_Type,Normal_Balance,Is_Cash_Account,Is_Active
        FROM Categories ORDER BY FIELD(Account_Type,'Asset','Liability','Equity','Income','Expense'),
        Account_Code IS NULL,Account_Code,Name,CategoryID

SELECT j.id FROM journal_entries j LEFT JOIN journal_entry_lines l ON l.journal_entry_id=j.id
            LEFT JOIN Categories c ON c.CategoryID=l.account_id
            WHERE j.status='posted' AND j.entry_date<? AND EXISTS
            (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entry_lines t WHERE t.journal_entry_id=j.id AND t.account_id=?)
            GROUP BY j.id HAVING COUNT(l.id)<2 OR SUM(l.debit_amount)<>SUM(l.credit_amount)
            OR SUM(l.debit_amount)<=0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN c.CategoryID IS NOT NULL
            AND c.Account_Type IN ('Asset','Liability','Equity','Income','Expense')
            AND ((l.debit_amount>0 AND l.credit_amount=0) OR (l.credit_amount>0 AND l.debit_amount=0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)>0 LIMIT 1
